text_to_image_prompt:
Create ONE horizontal three-view closeup character sheet, front 0 degrees, exact 90-degree right-facing profile with only one eye visible, exact 180-degree rear. Equal scale, eye-level, whole hairstyle visible, shoulders crop, pure white background.
Premium semi-realistic dimensional 3D character CG: finely sculpted face, delicate luminous skin microtexture, soft subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, individual wispy hair strands, detailed fabric and metal. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with balanced fill, subtle contact shadow. No text, labels, watermark, frame or collage borders. Preserve original age, facial anatomy, ethnicity, hair, eyes and accessories.
Character design: Male age 29. Dark espresso layered hair with an uneven side sweep and light flyaways. Hazel-gray deep-set eyes, long oval face, subtle cleft rounded chin, high narrow cheekbones, slightly convex nose bridge, softly thin lips and low arched brows. Ivory beige skin. Black wool overcoat with a voluminous charcoal woven scarf wrapped neatly below the chin. Quiet thoughtful expression.

original_prompt: Edit this three-panel character turnaround sheet. Correct ONLY the CENTER panel, preserving the left frontal panel and right rear panel exactly. The center is currently angled slightly toward the viewer. Rotate the entire center head, neck, hairstyle, headpiece and shoulders an additional 15 degrees away from the viewer into a geometrically exact RIGHT-FACING 90-degree side profile. Only ONE eye, ONE eyebrow, ONE cheek, and ONE nostril should be visible. Far eye, far eyebrow and far lashes must be completely hidden behind the nasal bridge. Show a clean nose-mouth-chin silhouette at the right edge. Side face silhouette must read like a classical profile portrait, NOT a three-quarter view. Preserve this same fictional adult identity, facial proportions, hair, head ornaments, clothes and rendering quality. Retain 1536x1024 canvas, same head scale and placement, solid pure white background, same three panels, no text. Keep all highest ornaments inside the image.
